name: The majority voted in favour of [government amendments](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/debates/?id=2021-11-22.143.1), which means they passed and will now be part of the bill. They were introduced by Goldstein MP [Tim Wilson](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/representatives/goldstein/tim_wilson) (Liberal) and related to registration requirements and financial disclosure. ### What does the bill do? According to the [bill homepage](https://www.aph.gov.au/Parliamentary_Business/Bills_Legislation/Bills_Search_Results/Result?bId=r6752), the bill: > *Amends the Commonwealth Electoral Act 1918 to reduce from $500 000 to $100 000 the threshold for electoral expenditure that can be incurred by an individual or organisation before they are required to register as a political campaigner.* More detail is included in the [bills digest](https://www.aph.gov.au/Parliamentary_Business/Bills_Legislation/bd/bd2122a/22bd015), which is produced by the parliamentary library and is a useful nonpartisan document.
